c053.title: Anna Babysits
c053.story: On Saturday, Anna is the [[babysitter]] for the neighbors' kids. Lev is eight, and Mila is five. Anna has a list of fun [[activities|activity]] for the day. First Lev dresses up as a [[pirate]], and Mila is an angel. They play a game about a scary [[monster]] and a slow [[zombie]]. Mila gets scared, so they make cards with [[stickers|sticker]] and [[glitter]]. After lunch, they go to the park and ride the [[carousel]]. Nearby, a [[clown]] gives free rides on a [[pony]]. Lev runs around and acts like a silly [[buffoon]], and Mila laughs. At home, they make a [[collage]] about their day. Then Lev's big brother comes home in his [[boy scout]] uniform. The kids ask him, "Can Anna come again next Saturday?"

c055.title: Sofia's Coming Out
c055.story: On Sunday, Max's sister Sofia invites the whole family for dinner. She is nervous, because this dinner is her [[coming out]]. "I am [[queer]]," she says, "and I want you to meet my [[partner]], Dana." For a moment the room is quiet, and then Max gives his sister a big hug. Grandma asks many questions, and Dana kindly explains [[gender]] and what [[LGBT]] means. "Is queer the same as [[gay]]?" Grandma asks, and Dana says some people use both words. Dad admits that he believed an old stereotype from TV. Mom says that in her family, talking about feelings was always a [[taboo]]. "Not in this family," Grandma says, and she pours tea for Dana first. Max raises his glass: "To Sofia and Dana, with love and [[respect]]!"

c058.title: Max's First Office Day
c058.story: It is Friday, Max's first day at the [[office]]. A woman from [[HR]] gives him a [[badge]]. He meets his boss and the [[office manager]]. Kate, the [[assistant]], tells him about the [[dress code]]. Max looks down at his old jeans. Kate laughs: "Jeans are OK on Fridays!" At ten, the [[training]] starts in the [[meeting room]]. But Max's computer does not work. Kate calls the system [[administrator]], Oleh. "Everybody here calls me the [[admin]]," Oleh says. He fixes the computer fast. Max thinks, "I like this new job."

c061.title: A One-on-One with the Boss
c061.story: Max has worked at the office for three months. Today he has a [[one-on-one]] meeting with Ms. Lee, his [[supervisor]]. It is his first [[performance review]], and he feels nervous. Ms. Lee smiles and talks about his [[progress]] on the new project. "You have real [[potential]]," she says. She also likes his [[professionalism]] with difficult clients. Then the [[director]] comes in with an envelope. Inside is a small [[bonus]] for Max! The good news gives him a big [[boost]]. That evening, Max tells Anna, "My [[boss]] is great!" "Which one, the supervisor or the [[manager]]?" Anna asks. Max laughs and says, "Both! And next month I get [[one-to-one]] English lessons." Then he buys pizza for Anna and their friends.

c062.title: Sofia Works Freelance
c062.story: On Saturday, Max visits his sister Sofia and says, "Hey, sis!" Sofia is a [[freelancer]], and she works from home. She started [[freelance]] work after she left her old office. Right now she is writing an [[invoice]] for a client. On the wall there is a big [[calendar]] with colorful notes. She plans her week in a [[task manager]] app too. "I read a lot about [[time management]]," she says. Last month she tried career [[coaching]] online. Her coach told her that [[networking]] brings new clients. "But do you ever rest?" Max asks. Sofia laughs and closes her laptop. "For me, [[work-life balance]] is important!"
